Selected-class regression fixture

Public int8 sources from the supplied ABAPiti extras. Runner rows captured with:

```sh
GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false GOCACHE="$PWD/.local/support-work/go-cache" GOTMPDIR="$PWD/.local/support-work/go-tmp" OSD_HEAVY_RANGE=50-59 tools/osd-heavy.sh node tools/osgo-unit.mjs .local/abapiti/int8 --class ZCL_ABAPITI_INT8X --json
```

Only classes, compiled, totals and rows are retained; volatile paths and timings are omitted.
